definitions.explanation: Rice seasoned with a mixture of vinegar, sugar, and salt, used as the base for sushi. Also called シャリ in sushi restaurant terminology.

examples.japanese: {酢飯|すめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

examples.english: Mix vinegar into freshly cooked rice to make sushi rice.

examples.japanese: おいしい⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{酢飯|すめし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ}つけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To make delicious sushi, the seasoning of the vinegared rice is important.

notes:
USAGE:
{酢飯|すめし} is the standard term used in cooking. At sushi restaurants, the same rice is called シャリ, which is the professional/insider term.

PREPARATION:
{酢飯|すめし} is made by mixing ⟦{合|あ}わせ{酢|ず}→合わせ酢：17502_awasezu⟧ (seasoned vinegar — a blend of ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧, ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧, and ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧) into hot cooked rice while fanning it to cool.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酢飯|すめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make sushi rice)
- {酢飯|すめし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ}つけ (seasoning of sushi rice)
- {酢飯|すめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧ (to shape sushi rice by hand)
